title: First Repeated Signal
description: Scan an integer sequence from left to right and return the first value whose occurrence is seen for the second time. If every value is unique, return -1.
inputFormat: First line: n. Second line: n integers.
outputFormat: Print the first repeated value, or -1 if no value repeats.
hints: Keep a set of values that have already appeared.

examples.explanation: 7 is the first value encountered for the second time.
